properties.name: RECURRENCE (2026-10-05, field log on 0.76.0, re-measured on 0.78.0 and main): one store holds every session's writes and records which session made none of them, so an export to commit one session's work also carries another's uncommitted work (field: export deferred twice in one day). Main's item layout makes each node its own file, so a person can stage only their own. Nothing tells them which items are theirs
properties.statement:
Field log entry [friction] of 2026-10-01 (art:vscode-call-field-log-2026-10-05): "'Export once per commit that changed the graph' collides with a store that also holds another session's uncommitted work: committing unrelated changes means either sweeping that WIP into the export or skipping the export. Twice today the export was deferred for this reason." The [works] entries the same day show compare_designs against the committed export is how the reporter saw the other session's 20 and 49 unexported nodes.

② PRECEDENT: fact:the-live-graph-does-not-branch-so-two-open-prs-collide (2026-08-14, reproduced four times on 2026-09-06), and the open dec:idea-the-design-gets-a-branch-dimension-for-implementation-facts. Counted as a recurrence of that mechanism on a new axis (two sessions, not two branches).

MEASURED, `--call`, a git repository with one committed export, then two new requirements standing for "mine" and "theirs", then one export:
- 0.78.0: export_graph to a directory is refused ("Is a directory"). The only form is the single file, which holds both new nodes.
- main (the item layout, #672, shipped in v0.79.0): the export wrote design/nodes/Requirement/req%3Amine.json and req%3Atheirs.json as two untracked files. So `git add` of one file commits one session's node and leaves the other's unstaged.
- On every version the store records no session for a door write: writes_for does not outlast its call (fact:recurrence-a-door-call-cannot-hold-a-seat-a-claim-or-a-writes-for-2026-10-05), so no AUTHORED_BY marks whose node it is.

CLASSIFICATION: still present as a class. Main lowers the cost from "defer the export" to "stage by file", for a hub that moves to the item layout (cap:a-project-migrates-to-the-item-layout is planned). Choosing the right files still rests on the person knowing which ids they wrote, because nothing in the store says so. The reporter's ideas (export a region or an epoch range; loop_status listing unexported changes by epoch) belong to the ideas triage and are not decided here.

NOT MEASURED: an edge both sessions' nodes share (one edge file, carried by whichever is staged), and the per-item lineage gate on a partly staged export.
